statements.quote: 49% is what I am seeing the 2-3 quarters in this today I believe that keeping that and trying to improve that should be our objective in the next 2-3 quarters
statements.target: Gross margin of 49% for next 2–3 quarters; longer-term target of 50%–52% odd margin

statements.quote: in the period of 3-4 years, as we said, we try to target a $100 million business in this segment, the niche area
statements.target: Non-agchem specialty segment (including electronic chemicals) to reach USD 100 million revenue

statements.quote: we continue to invest 3% to 4% of our revenue in R&D, which are fully charged to the P&L
statements.target: R&D spend of 3%–4% of revenue, fully expensed

statements.quote: Order book position is around USD 1.25 billion
statements.target: Order book at approximately USD 1.25 billion

statements.quote: there is a longer gestation, yes, we have already started to see early shoots for the ramp up. Next year we will see some good ramp up happening there
statements.target: Pharma CDMO ramp-up visible next year; earlier stated target of Rs 500–600 crore revenue with EBITDA breakeven in 2–3 years (timing now implying a longer gestation)

statements.quote: In the next three to four years, we should have some of these markets showing the colours… they are sizable in terms of what we are looking at the opportunity
statements.target: Next wave of 2–3 new molecules (chemical and bio) in advanced stages; revenues expected to emerge in 3–4 years

statements.quote: All the new molecules which we have been commercializing, account for 16% to 18% of our Ag Chem exports business… on a yearly basis, it is around 16% to 18%
statements.target: Newer molecules represent 16%–18% of AgChem exports revenue annually

statements.quote: The normalization… we are putting all pressure to make sure that we continue to manage these gross margins at the level that it is today. Okay, that is the normalized level
statements.target: Management characterises 47%–48% as the near-term normalized gross margin floor given sustained input cost pressure and pricing dynamics
